sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith Master - Part 8 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I have an interesting order here. Not just one usual piece of art, but two in one order. I think you can do it. The first piece is a Remington Model 700 sniper rifle with a full AB Arms body kit, with powerful optic and a silencer. Ergonomics not less than 35, recoil sum - less than 500. And make it lightweight, with a small magazine. The second piece is a Colt M1911 pistol, with a Pachmayr grip, Anarchy Outdoors muzzle brake and a flashlight of any kind."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 38 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Modify an M700 to comply with the given specifications
- Modify an M1911 to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +27,700 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.03
- 1× Pistol case
- 3× 7.62x51mm M993 ammo pack (20 pcs)
- Unlocks purchase of AR-15 HK Ergo PSG-1 style pistol grip at Mechanic LL4
- Unlocks purchase of AR-15 Strike Industries Advanced Receiver Extension (Black) at Mechanic LL4
"Okay, I see the bolty, and what about the handgun? There it is, my precious. Good work, friend. The next order is coming in tomorrow, so you can go do your own work until then."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
M700 specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 35 or more ergonomics
- 500 or less recoil
- 6 kg or less in weight
- 1500 or greater sighting range
- A silencer
- A magazine with a capacity of 5 or no magazine
- M700 AB Arms MOD*X GEN 3 chassis
- M700 AB Arms MOD*X GEN 3 KeyMod handguard
- M700 AB Arms MOD*X rail mount

M1911 specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 75 or more ergonomics
- 200 or greater sighting range
- Any tactical device (such as the NcSTAR Tactical Blue Laser)
- A magazine
- M1911 Pachmayr American Legend Grip #423
- M1911 Anarchy Outdoors .45 ACP muzzle brake

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- These builds are based on a standard M700 from Peacekeeper LL2 and a standard Colt M1911A1 .45 ACP pistol from Peacekeeper LL1.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
